code: rd <- tools::Rd_db (package = "stats") cor_rd <- rd [[grep ("^cor\\.Rd", names (rd))]] Rd_get_metadata <- utils::getFromNamespace (".Rd_get_metadata", "tools") Rd_get_metadata (cor_rd, "alias") #> [1] "var"     "cov"     "cor"     "cov2cor" tools::Rd2ex (cor_rd) #> ### Name: cor #> ### Title: Correlation, Variance and Covariance (Matrices) #> ### Aliases: var cov cor cov2cor #> ### Keywords: univar multivariate array #>  #> ### ** Examples #>  #> var(1:10)  # 9.166667 #>  #> var(1:5, 1:5) # 2.5 #>  #> ## Two simple vectors #> cor(1:10, 2:11) # == 1 #>  #> ## Correlation Matrix of Multivariate sample: #> (Cl <- cor(longley)) #> ## Graphical Correlation Matrix: #> symnum(Cl) # highly correlated #>  #> ## Spearman's rho  and  Kendall's tau #> symnum(clS <- cor(longley, method = "spearman")) #> symnum(clK <- cor(longley, method = "kendall")) #> ## How much do they differ? #> i <- lower.tri(Cl) #> cor(cbind(P = Cl[i], S = clS[i], K = clK[i])) #>  #>  #> ## cov2cor() scales a covariance matrix by its diagonal #> ##           to become the correlation matrix. #> cov2cor # see the function definition {and learn ..} #> stopifnot(all.equal(Cl, cov2cor(cov(longley))), #>           all.equal(cor(longley, method = "kendall"), #>             cov2cor(cov(longley, method = "kendall")))) #>  #> ##--- Missing value treatment: #> C1 <- cov(swiss) #> range(eigen(C1, only.values = TRUE)$values) # 6.19        1921 #>  #> ## swM := "swiss" with  3 "missing"s : #> swM <- swiss #> colnames(swM) <- abbreviate(colnames(swiss), minlength=6) #> swM[1,2] <- swM[7,3] <- swM[25,5] <- NA # create 3 "missing" #>  #> ## Consider all 5 "use" cases : #> (C. <- cov(swM)) # use="everything"  quite a few NAs in cov.matrix #> try(cov(swM, use = "all")) # Error: missing obs... #> C2 <- cov(swM, use = "complete") #> stopifnot(identical(C2, cov(swM, use = "na.or.complete"))) #> range(eigen(C2, only.values = TRUE)$values) # 6.46   1930 #> C3 <- cov(swM, use = "pairwise") #> range(eigen(C3, only.values = TRUE)$values) # 6.19   1938 #>  #> ## Kendall's tau doesn't change much: #> symnum(Rc <- cor(swM, method = "kendall", use = "complete")) #> symnum(Rp <- cor(swM, method = "kendall", use = "pairwise")) #> symnum(R. <- cor(swiss, method = "kendall")) #>  #> ## "pairwise" is closer componentwise, #> summary(abs(c(1 - Rp/R.))) #> summary(abs(c(1 - Rc/R.))) #>  #> ## but "complete" is closer in Eigen space: #> EV <- function(m) eigen(m, only.values=TRUE)$values #> summary(abs(1 - EV(Rp)/EV(R.)) / abs(1 - EV(Rc)/EV(R.)))

title: autotest, pkgcheck, goodpractice - which tool does what?
text: goodpractice package intended , Give advice good practices building R packages. Advice includes functions syntax avoid, package structure, code complexity, code formatting, etc. goodpractice package initially developed wrapper around three separate packages, produced single integrated report output : rcmdcheck run R CMD check within R session; covr analyse report test coverage; cyclocomp analyse cycylomatic complexity package functions. since extended include many aspects general good practices R package development. goodpractice implements large suite checks defined within following “check groups”: covr: Test coverage report ‘covr’ package. cyclocomp: Function cyclocomplexity ‘cyclocomp’ package; default limit 50. description: Check common issues DESCRIPTION files, including formatting issues URLs, DOIs, BugReports, package names, author contributor roles lintr: Check package linting ‘lintr’ package (84 linters total). namespace: Check import export patterns NAMESPACE file rcmdcheck: Run ‘R CMD check’ via ‘rcmdcheck’ package. ~200 checks documentation, namespace, compilation, tests, vignettes, CRAN compliance. rd: Check whether ’man/*.Rd’ function documentation includes example code return values (regardless whether documentation files generated ‘Roxygen2’). revdep: Check whether package reverse dependencies, recommending running ‘reddev’ package . roxygen2: packages within use ‘Roxygen2’ generate documentation. Checks best practices Roxygen2 tag usage, flags unknown tags, ensures ‘inheritParams’ used correctly. code_structure: Common issues like duplicated unused function bodies, ‘print()’ returns insivibly, ‘.exit()’ uses ‘add = TRUE’, checks function length (default max50 lines). package_structure: Generic checks like whether package README, NEWS file, whether files use ‘.R’ extension, ‘.r’. spelling: Check spelling ‘spelling’ package. tidyverse: Check compliance Tidyverse style guide; mostly via ‘lintr’ package. (checks run default; ‘tidyverse_checks()’ added ‘checks_by_group()’. urlchecker: Check whether URLs valid, includingidentifying redirects. vignette: Check vignette code use either ‘rm()’ ‘setwd()’.

title: autotest 0.1.0
text: Replaced entire YAML/example-parsing pipeline underpinned autotesting since 0.0.x one built typetracer: autotest_package() now traces actual calls made package’s examples, tests, vignettes, rather statically parsing re-executing example code. Reimplemented untested-function/untested-parameter checks top new trace-based data. Added progress parameter autotest_package(), replacing quiet, finer control console output. Suppressed plot/PDF file artifacts progress-bar noise generated autotest_package() runs.

title: autotest 0.1.0
text: Fixed formals lookup package-reload gaps uncovered merging typetracer pipeline. Fixed resolution unexported functions autotesting. Fixed namespace-qualified (pkg::fn) call tracing. Fixed parameter parsing/cleanup left old yaml-based get_params/scrape-examples.R code. Removed now-orphaned internals old pipeline (yaml_handlers(), R/parse-yaml.R, R/example-objects.R, R/text-parsing-fns.R, unused yaml-parsing code). Switched checkmate input assertion checks. Renamed package parameter pkg consistency. Bumped roxygen2 8.1 added exportS3Method tags. Updated repo status badge “active”.

title: autotest 0.0.2
text: Added first cut typetracer-based tracing alternative example-execution backend, laying groundwork 0.1.0 rewrite. Added check_param_is_arbitrary() skip mutation-testing parameters whose values arbitrary characters. Added documented_int_range() related handling documented integer ranges (upper/lower, positive/negative) properly tested. Added hex sticker/logo package. Added CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md allcontributors setup.

title: autotest 0.0.2
text: Fixed autotest_single_yaml() returning 0-row data frame instead NULL items report testable. Fixed parsing bracket sequences spanning multi-line quoted expressions. Fixed parsing -line code comments quoted sequences containing escape characters (remove_comments(), quote_sequences()). Fixed handling packages installed non-standard library paths. Fixed get_Rd_value() use Rd2txt() instead manual parsing, fixed related Rd-extraction bugs (get_pkg_functions(), get_Rd_param(), rm_dontrun_lines()). Fixed function-alias grepping functions called via aliases correctly identified. Fixed single_or_vec() correctly evaluate parameter expressions treat atomic classes vectors. Fixed double_noise test vectors containing NAs adjusted sensitivity threshold. Fixed test_int_as_dbl comparisons less sensitive spurious differences. Fixed split_content_at_commas(), rm_commas_in_qts(), extract_primary_call_content() range edge cases (quoted strings, matrix results apply(), expression delimiters). Fixed package-name/dependency extraction DESCRIPTION (missing Imports, multi-line comma-separated fields, package name first line). Fixed test-flag propagation across various input-* test functions test = FALSE honoured consistently.

title: autotest 0.0.2
text: Moved project ropenscilabs ropensci-review-tools GitHub organisation recommended r-universe installation. Migrated CI GitHub Actions v2/v4 workflows added code-coverage workflow. Switched default status messages assumed parameters “assume” “state” wording clarity. Various internal refactors reduce cyclomatic complexity improve consistency variable naming.

title: autotest 0.0.1
text: 2020-07-03 – 2021-02-23 Initial development package’s core autotesting framework.

title: autotest 0.0.1
text: Added original YAML-based pipeline scraping function-call examples package’s Rd files source, converting structured YAML test specification (examples_to_yaml() friends). Added autotest_rectangular(), autotest_vector(), autotest_single() systematically mutate rectangular (data.frame/matrix), vector, single-value (integer, double, character, logical, name/formula) inputs check functions respond sensibly (informative errors/warnings rather silent failure). Added autotest_package() run autotesting across every function package, including packages provided local/source directories well installed packages. Added structured report_object/tibble return value, columns progressively built include test_name, parameter_type, operation, content, plus summary() method returned object. Added tests whether function return values match documented class description (test_return_has_class, test_return_desc). Added tests whether parameter documentation matches classes objects actually passed examples (param_docs_match_input). Added detection untested functions parameters (test_untested_params), including identification parameters meaningfully tested left default values. Added autotest_obj S3 class moved dispatch rectangular/vector/single/return tests onto S3 methods, replacing long /else chains. Added autotest_types parameter/function control categories test run. Added test_data parameter allowing user-supplied replacement values threaded rectangular, vector, single-value tests instead auto-generated ones. Added testthat integration via expect_autotest_no_err(), expect_autotest_no_warn(), expect_autotest_notes(), expect_autotest_no_testdata(). Added git-hash tracking source packages report output. Added package vignette describing autotest’s design, plus second vignette controlling tests run.

title: autotest 0.0.1
text: Numerous fixes example-code parser: matching nested/mismatched brackets, multi-line piped expressions, -line comments, quoted strings, \%-escaped operators, dontrun/donttest blocks. Numerous fixes matching parameter return-object classes documented descriptions. Switched CI run GitHub Actions, added R CMD check workflow across multiple OSes, set pkgdown.
